data.headline: Customer Success Leader | SaaS & Healthcare Tech | Driving Product Adoption, Retention & Operational Excellence | Cross Functional Leader | Bills Fan
data.about:
At Bayer Pharmaceuticals, driving excellence in digital fulfillment operations and customer success has been my mission, with a focus on SaaS models, I directed  the successful onboarding of clients, ensuring seamless integration of digital solutions into healthcare practices.

My tenure has been characterized by the creation of impactful business plans and the establishment of Customer Success as a Service, which expanded our reach to over 1,300 sites. By prioritizing customer-defined objectives and fostering collaborative efforts, the team delivered substantial hours of adoption and exploration, enhancing customer satisfaction, retention. and expansion of services . This strategic approach has solidified our position as leaders in the digital healthcare space.

When I'm not at work you'll find me exploring some of the beautiful WNY parks, snowboarding at one of our local resorts, or cheering proudly for our Buffalo Bills and Sabres

description.text:
•	Led cross-functional team in Digital Solutions Business on two Focused Process Excellence Charter Achieved a 30% reduction in Radimetrics Support Cases and a $434,000 reduction in labor costs. This software supports dose reporting and tracking, protocol management, and benchmarking.  

•	Developed a new risk mitigation framework, eliminating $500K of unrecognized revenue by optimizing implementation timelines and improving financial forecasting.	

•	Implemented a scalable customer engagement survey process, increasing actionable feedback and driving improvements in Net Promoter Score (NPS) and customer satisfaction (CSAT) for our Radimetrics™ Enterprise Platform (REP), focusing on both Radiation Dose Management (RDM) and Contrast Dose Management (CDM) solutions

•	Increased data access for future projects by building processes that integrated anonymized customer data into the Bayer Data Lake, resulting in 40% growth in imaging studies and 67 TB of data collected within two months

Led the Customer Success team to deliver exceptional service and support to clients, resulting in increased customer retention and satisfaction.  

•Created and implemented national business plan templates for Customer Success Team to use at their accounts. Established business plans, sprints, and customer desired outcomes at 150 Tier 1 accounts.

• Established Customer Success as a Service, supporting over 1,300 customer sites and achieving 15,000+ hours of adoption efforts, leading to increased customer satisfaction (CSAT) and customer value realization.

•Led server upgrade initiatives across 706 installations, coordinating efforts between Clinical, Service, and Project Management teams.

•Optimized onboarding processes by introducing self-service options, improving FTE efficiency by 65% and CSAT scores by 30% within the first year.

•Led strategic initiatives in Clinical Informatics, optimizing processes and systems to achieve enhanced clinical outcomes. 

•Onboarded 6 new Clinical Experts and maintained a focus on customer success, averaging 3,358 customer-facing hours in the East Region.

•Improved processes to standardize onsite training delivery, resulting in the implementation of 118 new sites in 2016 and a 27% increase in training hours compared to the previous year

•Built process and implemented the Clinical Teams first remote training sessions for Clinical Education Services.  Goal was a Reduction in Service calls, increased customer satisfaction, and increased customer adoption of software.

description.text:
•Led a team of 15 clinical specialists, delivering top-tier customer support and earning Clinical Zone of the Year recognition in 4 out of 5 years


•Created processes to properly measure teams and reps efforts. Allowed for consistent effort across teams and zones, relief for active territories, annual recognition. 

•Successfully maintained and developed East Zone medical device and contrast dose management customer accounts, while also establishing new accounts to drive business growth. Achieved an NPS score of 9.8 for professionalism and 9.7 for customer training by managing Tier 1 customer accounts and optimizing service delivery

•Developed top talent, with multiple team members advancing into leadership, marketing, and product management roles.

• Provided expert training and support on Certegra - Bayer’s Initial Informatics Offering, increasing product adoption by 150% from year 1 to year 2.

• Facilitated product evaluations and in services for customers, managing 100 Certegra implementations across the US and Canada.

• Developed and maintained effective relationships with dealers, OEMs, internal IT partners, and contrast companies.
